_comment: Rules for the counter engine. Pure data so weights/logic are tunable without code changes. Predicate fields: candidate / lane_opponent (subject specs with all/any/none flag lists); enemy_team / my_team (count specs, or a list of them). A count spec is {flag|flags|any_flags, min?, max?}: 'flag'=has it, 'flags'=has ALL, 'any_flags'=has ANY. Reason tokens: {enemy_with:FLAG}, {team_with:FLAG}, {enemy_with_all:F1,F2}, {enemy_with_any:F1,F2}. 'reason' = shown when the rule FIRES; 'gap' = shown when the draft offers this reward but the candidate misses it (drives the 'why not 100' breakdown). lane_partner (subject spec) = duo-synergy predicate matched against your BOT-LANE partner (ally utility when you are bottom, ally bottom when you are utility); requires callers to pass ally_roles.

rules._section: ARCHETYPE-IDENTITY rules (added to give proactive win-condition champs a non-crowded niche). Each rewards an ARCHETYPE vs a DRAFT SHAPE, never a named matchup. 'no_scale' = absence/team-shape gate, weight not diluted by enemy count.
